mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dodo_restock_subscription (id, user_id, store_id, shop_id, scheme_id, goods_id, goods_name, goods_img, state, generation, version, subscribed_at, expires_at, next_check_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{storeId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{shopId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{schemeId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{goodsId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{goodsName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{goodsImg,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{state,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{generation,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{version,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{subscribedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{expiresAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{nextCheckAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{updatedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = id
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM dodo_restock_subscription WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND store_id = #{storeId} AND shop_id = #{shopId} AND goods_id = #{goodsId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM dodo_restock_subscription WHERE store_id = #{storeId} AND shop_id = #{shopId} AND goods_id = #{goodsId} ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE dodo_restock_subscription SET next_check_at = #{nextCheckAt} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE dodo_restock_subscription SET next_check_at = #{nextCheckAt} WHERE store_id = #{storeId} AND shop_id = #{shopId} AND goods_id = #{goodsId} AND state = 'WAITING'
mapper.sql: FROM dodo_restock_subscription s LEFT JOIN dodo_restock_supply p ON p.store_id = s.store_id AND p.shop_id = s.shop_id AND p.goods_id = s.goods_id WHERE s.store_id = #{storeId} GROUP BY s.store_id, s.shop_id, s.goods_id
mapper.select:
SELECT s.store_id, s.shop_id, s.goods_id, MAX(s.goods_name) AS goods_name, SUM(CASE WHEN s.state = 'WAITING' AND s.expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS waiting_count, MIN(s.subscribed_at) AS first_subscribed_at, MAX(p.state) AS supply_state, MAX(p.owner_name) AS owner_name, MAX(p.reason) AS reason, MAX(p.expected_at) AS expected_at, MAX(p.version) AS version
ORDER BY waiting_count DESC, first_subscribed_at LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{start}
